## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=3 at ~$1.50 entry premium = $450/trade. At 50% risk cap, requires $900+ account. $1K paper realizes ~100% headline; $25K+ needed for full 28-contract scale.
2. **Sample bias:** 7-day anchor window (4/29–5/07 2026) — extremely small, hand-selected by J as "source of truth." Grinder searched 432+ combos over this same window → severe selection bias. Any "keeper" is overfit to these 7 days by construction.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS — no walk-forward or held-out window tested. The Stage-1 kitchen run (empty combo) showed edge_capture=759.21 but wide_pnl=-$1,464, WR=18.7%, top5_pct=999% (extreme concentration), max DD=$4,701 — all red flags.
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS — grinder uses BS-synthetic pricing (black_scholes) over historical SPY/VIX bars. Per L23, BS sim systematically overestimates ITM 0DTE entry premiums by 10-25%; real OPRA fills flip 3 of 4 measured days from BS-winners to losses.
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Misses 2/3 J winner days (4/29, 5/04) entirely
   - Adds a losing trade on 5/05 (+$40.54 in BS sim, likely negative real-fills)
   - Wide_pnl negative in baseline run (-$1,464 over 225 trades)
   - Max drawdown $4,701 on $1K notional = 4.7× account blowup risk
   - Only 2/6 quarters positive (2025-Q2, 2026-Q1)
6. **Concentration:** Stage-1 baseline top5_pct=999% (top 5 days produce 9.99× total P&L; other 290+ days net lose). Keeper by_day shows only 2 non-zero days (5/01, 5/05) — 100% concentration.

3. Concentration gate: top5_pct ≤ 200% (per L04)
4. Quarterly stability: ≥4/6 quarters positive
5. OP-16 floor: edge_capture ≥ 771 (50% of 1542 max)
